2257.description_text: The perfect, healthy choice for your sweet tooth, KAL Sure Stevia Organic Extract delivers the great taste you’re looking for in a zero-calorie sweetener. We searched the world over to find the best-tasting organic stevia. Derived from the leaves of a small shrub in the chrysanthemum family, this plant-based sweetener contains steviosides, substances unique to stevia plants, known for their intense sweetness. Our low-glycemic stevia extract should not affect blood glucose levels in most individuals, and unlike products that use the whole herb, it has no strong aftertaste, so you get all the sweet goodness without the bitterness of many stevia products. Our unflavored, organic powder is great for baking and dessert recipes, and comes in an easy-to-use shaker bottle. You can also try it in your coffee or tea, or add it to cold drinks for some extra sweetness. Trust KAL to deliver the best-tasting organic stevia, made in small batches in our own facility and lab tested to ensure purity, potency and quality. 2265.description_text: Support your hair care routine with the help of SesZenBio™! Enjoy a sweet & refreshing strawberry watermelon flavored liquid to help improve hair density & thickness among women having poor hair and having experienced normal hair loss with age, and as observed by participants in one study, helps support stronger hair. How It Works Hair Density & Thickness: SesZenBio™ is a unique complex that can help increase hair density & thickness among women having poor hair and having experienced normal hair loss with age. Thicker, Stronger Hair: This ingredient also helps to support thicker and stronger hair, as observed by participants in one study. Skin Support: In women, SesZenBio may also help to reduce crow’s feet wrinkles and fine lines, as well as improve skin texture, elasticity, and skin hydration. Biotin for Hair, Skin, & Nails: With biotin included, you’ll also support healthy hair, skin, and nails. Collagen Production: Vitamin C is an essential vitamin that helps maintain normal collagen formation, contributing to skin health. Antioxidant Support & Immunity: Vitamin C is also an antioxidant that helps to protect cellular health while supporting immune function. Your Routine, Your Way: Enjoy this easy-to-take & delicious blueberry pomegranate or strawberry watermelon flavored liquid hair formula on its own or mixed into your favorite smoothie, for delicious everyday hair support. How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Ages 18+, take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice, or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. With 56 days of continued usage at 1 serving per day. This bottle provides 16 servings. A: While both products contain ingredients for your hair, the Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth is a broad spectrum multivitamin that contains Lustriva®, which is clinically shown in women to help grow thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks. Our Daily Liquid Hair Formula is not a multivitamin, and contains a different unique ingredient called SesZenBio™, which can help increase hair density & thickness among women having poor hair and having experienced normal hair loss with age with 56 days of continued usage at 1 serving per day. This bottle provides 16 servings. Q: Can I take this product and the Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth together? A: While both the Daily Liquid Hair Formula and Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth contain different ingredients for hair, they do have certain overlapping nutrients. If you’d like to receive the benefits of both of these supplements, our best recommendation is to consult with your physician or healthcare professional who can help determine what may be best for you. Q: What is SesZenBio™? A: SesZenBio™ is a proprietary herbal extract derived from Sesbania grandiflora (L.) commonly known as Agati. Q: Why is SesZenBio™ included in this formula? A: SesZenBio™ is included to help promote beauty from within by providing skin support for women and hair support for those having poor hair and having experienced normal hair loss with age. Q: What are the benefits of SesZenBio™? A: SesZenBio™ may help to reduce crow's feet wrinkles and fine lines and help improve skin texture, elasticity, and skin hydration in women. SesZenBio™ can also help to support growth of existing hair by improving hair density and thickness among those having poor hair and having experienced normal hair loss with age. As observed by participants in one study, SesZenBio™ may help support thicker and stronger hair. Q: How should I take this? A: Shake well before use. Ages 18+, take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice, or on an empty stomach. Since this product has ingredients specifically for your hair routine, we recommend combining it with our Liquid Morning Multivitamin and Liquid Nighttime Multimineral for a complete routine! Q: How long should I take this product for to experience the benefits? A: SesZenBio™ may help provide skin and hair support after 56 days of use. Since each bottle provides 15 daily servings, we recommend taking 1 serving per day for 56 days. Q: Will this supplement help me with hair breakage? A: SesZenBio™ may help to support thicker and stronger hair, as observed by women having poor hair and having experienced normal hair loss in a 56-day study. Featuring EverZen™, a unique complex that increases total sleep time^^, along with L-Theanine to promote relaxation and ease occasional stress. With a convenient liquid format that fits naturally into your nighttime routine, it’s a simple way to support more restful nights — all without melatonin. 2273.description_text: Looking for a simple way to add more fiber to your day? This Vegan Liquid Fiber delivers up to 7g of fiber and features a blend of tapioca fiber and baobab fruit to provide an excellent source of fiber in a delicious liquid made for the whole family! Just two tablespoons of this psyllium husk free formula provides as much fiber as ½ cup of cubed avocado, 1 cup of carrots, or 1 grapefruit! How It Works Excellent Source of Fiber: Formulated with a blend of tapioca fiber and baobab fruit to provide an excellent source of fiber for the whole family ages 1 and up. Psyllium Husk Free: Formulated without psyllium husk, this vegan liquid fiber offers both soluble and insoluble fiber for an easy-to-take alternative for those looking to incorporate a fiber supplement into their daily routine. Organic Fiber for the Whole Family: Just two tablespoons provide as much fiber as ½ a cup of cubed avocado, 1 cup of carrots, or 1 grapefruit! Liquid Fiber, Made Easy: Incorporate this delicious liquid fiber as part of your daily water intake. Ages 1-3 will receive 3g of fiber per serving and should drink at least 4 fl oz of water, while ages 4+ receive 7g of fiber per serving should drink at least 8 fl oz of water with this liquid. Follow the dosing instructions listed below, starting with 1/3 dose and gradually increasing to a full dose, or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Water intake is important while taking a fiber supplement. To ensure proper hydration, ages 1-3 should drink at least 4 fl oz and ages 4+ should drink at least 8 fl oz with this liquid. Do not exceed the recommended dose. 1-3 Years: 1 Tablespoon (15 mL) 4+ Years: 2 Tablespoons (30 mL) Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate and use within 6 months after opening. A: Great question! Our Vegan Liquid fiber features a thoughtful blend of organic tapioca fiber and baobab fruit to provide an excellent source of fiber in an easy-to-take liquid format. It’s also psyllium husk free, offering an alternative option for those looking to incorporate fiber into their routine. Q: How much fiber does one serving provide?A: Just two tablespoons provide as much fiber as ½ cup of cubed avocado, 1 cup of carrots, or 1 cup of grapefruit, making it a simple way to add fiber to your day. Q: Why choose a liquid fiber instead of capsules or powders?A: Liquid fiber offers a convenient and flexible way to incorporate fiber into your daily routine. It can be taken on its own or mixed into your favorite beverage or smoothie, making it a simple alternative to capsules or powders. To ensure proper hydration, ages 1-3 should drink at least 4flozand ages 4+ should drink at least 8floz with this liquid. Q: What is FiberSMART®?A: FiberSMART® is a resistant dextrin dietary fiber made from non-GMO tapioca or non-GMO corn. It contains over 90% dietary fiber and can boost fiber intake. This ingredient is Non-GMO Project Verified. Q: What type of fiber is FiberSMART®?A: FiberSMART® is a soluble fiber. Q: What is Fibriss® baobab fiber?A: Fibriss® is an organic, wild-harvested baobab fruit powder that naturally contains both soluble and insoluble fiber, along with polyphenols. Q: What is baobab?A: Baobab is a fruit that comes from the African baobab tree (Adansonia), often referred to as the “Tree of Life.” The fruit naturally dries on the tree and is typically ground into a fine powder for use in foods and supplements. Q: Is Fibriss® FODMAP-friendly?A: Yes. Fibriss® baobab fiber is considered FODMAP-friendly. Q: What is OnoSweet®?A: OnoSweet® is a patented, natural sweetener made from Rebaudioside M (Reb M) that is produced through rice fermentation—not from stevia leaves. Q: Is OnoSweet® stevia-free?A: Yes. While Reb M is often associated with stevia, OnoSweet® is completely stevia-free and derived via rice fermentation, resulting in a neutral sweetness. 2279.description_text: Support your body at the cellular level with our convenient NADH Capsules formulated with niacin, a key vitamin that supports cellular energy, nervous system function, and overall wellness. Niacin also acts as a precursor to NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) to help your body with energy metabolism. Plus, trans-resveratrol offers targeted support for cognitive function and memory in postmenopausal women. How It Works Supports Cellular Energy: These capsules contain Niacin, an essential B vitamin that plays a key role in helping your body convert nutrients into usable energy at the cellular level. Precursor to NAD+: Niacin serves as a precursor to NAD (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide), an important coenzyme that exists as NAD+ and NADH in the energy metabolism process. Nervous System Function: Niacin also helps to maintain the normal function of the nervous system, including the brain. Made with Trans-Resveratrol: Sourced from Japanese Knotweed Root, Trans-Resveratrol supports memory and cognitive function for postmenopausal women. 120 mg of Niacin: Just one capsule delivers 120 mg of Niacin, supporting its role as a precursor to NAD+. CoQ10 & BioPerine: Includes 100 mg of Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) as Ubiquinol and 5 mg BioPerine®, a black pepper fruit extract standardized to 95% Piperine. Wellness On-the-Go: Capsules make it easy to incorporate NADH into your routine, whether at home or traveling. How To Take Suggested Use: Adults 18+, take 1 capsule daily with or without food, or as directed by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Keep out of reach of children in case of accidental overdose or choking. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. A: NADH Capsules are a dietary supplement formulated with Niacin to support cellular energy and act as a precursor to NAD (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide). Each capsule combines NADH (the reduced form of NAD) with niacin, trans-resveratrol, coenzyme Q10, and BioPerine®. Q: What are the key benefits? A: The key benefits of this product come from Niacin, an essential B vitamin. Niacin supports cellular energy in the body by acting as a precursor to NAD, an important coenzyme involved in energy metabolism. NAD exists as either an oxidized form (NAD+) or a reduced form (NADH) in the energy metabolism process. Additionally, Niacin also helps maintain the function of the nervous system, including the brain. Q: Does MaryRuth’s test products for Quality Assurance? A: Yes! 2280.description_text: Built around the routines Michelle Kwan relies on every day, this thoughtfully curated bundle bring together gentle, nourishing support for morning, day, and night! Inspired by Michelle’s belief in consistency and care, on and off the ice, these are the products she reaches for to support her daily wellness routine. Start your morning with the bestselling Liquid Morning Multivitamin, a delicious, easy-to-take liquid that delivers essential nutrients to support energy metabolism and daily wellness. On days when you need extra immunity support, enjoy the Vitamin C Gummies, a convenient and travel-friendly option with a tasty citrus flavor you’ll enjoy. In the evening, enjoy the Liquid Nighttime Multimineral + Skin Renew, a great addition to your bedtime routine with Sepitone™, clinically shown in women to improve skin elasticity, firmness, and fine wrinkles, plus nutrients to support bone health and more. How It Works Liquid Morning Multivitamin Daily Nutrient Support: Our very first formula, created to make it easier than ever to get nutrients your body needs — in a delicious, easy-to-take liquid multivitamin. Broad-Spectrum Formula: A nourishing blend of essential vitamins and minerals, including antioxidant vitamin C, plus vitamins D, E, and beta carotene. Energy Metabolism Support: B vitamins help support energy metabolism and a healthy nervous system. B-Vitamin Blend: Includes B6, biotin, folate, pantothenic acid, and bioavailable B12 to support important functions — from circulatory health to mood and cognitive performance. Antioxidant Properties: Vitamin C supports your body by helping limit free radical damage and protecting cells from oxidative stress, contributing to immune function and overall wellbeing. Immunity & Bone Support: Vitamin D3, the same type of vitamin D produced when your skin is exposed to sunlight, supports bone health and immune function. For the Whole Family: Formulated for women, men, and kids ages 1 and up, this easy-to-take liquid multivitamin offers daily wellness the whole household can share. Vitamin C Gummies Essential Vitamin: Human bodies are unable to synthesize vitamin C on their own, which makes it an essential vitamin! Immune Support: As an antioxidant, vitamin C helps protect cells from oxidative stress, contributing to the normal function of the immune system. Collagen Formation: This essential vitamin plays an important role in collagen formation, which contributes to the normal structure of skin, bones, and blood vessels. Iron Absorption: By supporting the body’s absorption of iron, vitamin C makes it easier for your body to use this important mineral. No Gelatin: These tasty, orange-flavored gummies are made with pectin instead of gelatin for a vegan-friendly formula. Liquid Nighttime Multimineral + Skin Renew Bedtime Routine: Support healthy hair, skin, and nails with this berry-flavored liquid as a part of your nighttime routine, all with no hard-to-swallow pills and NO melatonin! Just like our original liquid nighttime formulas, this multimineral contains seven minerals — magnesium, calcium, zinc, selenium, copper, manganese, and chromium. Skin Elasticity & Firmness: With Sepitone, clinically shown in women to help increase skin elasticity, this nighttime formula supports healthy aging and may promote a youthful skin appearance. This trademarked ingredient is also clinically shown in women to help improve skin firmness and texture, offering extra care in your nighttime routine. Wrinkle Reduction: Sepitone is clinically shown in women to help reduce fine wrinkles and even helps to reduce wrinkle depth and crow’s feet wrinkles, supporting beauty from within. Immunity & Skin Health: Zinc helps support immunity, maintain skin health, and aid DNA synthesis and repair. Antioxidant & Thyroid Support: Selenium acts as an antioxidant and supports normal thyroid function, making it an important part of overall wellness. Mineral Absorption & Bone Health: Vitamin D helps support and maintain mineral absorption, bone health, and muscle function. How To Take Liquid Morning MultivitaminSuggested Use: Shake well before use. Take once daily following the dosing instructions listed below, or dose as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Suggested Dosage: 1-3 Years: 1/2 Teaspoon (2.5 mL) 4-13 Years: 1 Tablespoon (15 mL) 14 Years+: 2 Tablespoons (30 mL) In order to make the best health decisions possible for your child, we always recommend speaking with your pediatrician, physician, or healthcare professional to help determine the best dose for your child. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. Vitamin C GummiesSuggested Use: Ages 4+, take one gummy daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Keep out of reach of children in case of accidental overdose or choking. Store in a cool, dry place. Liquid Nightttime Multimineral + Skin RenewSuggested Use: Shake well before use. Adults 18+, take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) once daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take about 10 min to 1 hour before bed, either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a dry, cool place. Refrigerate after opening. Use within 6 months of opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Brain Function: Lutein and zeaxanthin also provide an added benefit of supporting cognitive function. Easy Daily Routine: These delicious citrus squeeze gummies make consistent eye health and vision support enjoyable and convenient for the whole family — no hard-to-swallow pills or capsules needed! 2283.description_text: Support your beauty from within, day and night, with this powerful daily routine! This curated bundle of our viral peach mango flavored Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth, berry-flavored Liquid Nighttime Multimineral + Skin Renew, and unflavored Organic Liquid Probiotic is made to support energy metabolism, gut health, help women grow thicker, fuller hair as well as increase skin elasticity, improve skin firmness and texture, and reduce facial wrinkles! Plus, you'll support daily wellness and create healthy AM and PM routines with vitamins and minerals your body needs in easy-to-take liquid formulas. What are the Benefits? Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth Clinically Shown for Hair Growth: Features Lustriva®, shown in women to support thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks! This ingredient helps the growth of existing hair by increasing hair thickness. Supports Smoother Skin: Lustriva® also helps reduce facial wrinkles while improving skin smoothness. Daily Energy Metabolism: B vitamins help support energy metabolism, circulatory health, immunity, and the nervous system. This liquid multivitamin includes all eight B vitamins, including 10,000 mcg biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin — as well as folate as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Beauty From Within: Biotin, zinc, and B vitamins support skin, hair, and nail health. Bone & Mood Support: Vitamin D3 supports bone health, muscle function, and mood support. Liquid Nighttime Multimineral + Skin Renew Bedtime Routine: Support healthy hair, skin, and nails with this berry-flavored liquid as a part of your nighttime routine, all with no hard-to-swallow pills and NO melatonin! Just like our original liquid nighttime formulas, this multimineral contains seven minerals — magnesium, calcium, zinc, selenium, copper, manganese, and chromium. Skin Elasticity & Firmness: With Sepitone®, clinically shown in women to help increase skin elasticity, this nighttime formula supports healthy aging and may promote a youthful skin appearance. This trademarked ingredient is also clinically shown in women to help improve skin firmness and texture, offering extra care in your nighttime routine. Wrinkle Reduction: Sepitone is clinically shown in women to help reduce facial wrinkles and even helps to reduce wrinkle depth and crow’s feet wrinkles, supporting beauty from within. Immunity & Skin Health: Zinc helps support immunity, maintain skin health, and aid DNA synthesis and repair. Antioxidant & Thyroid Support: Selenium acts as an antioxidant and supports normal thyroid function, making it an important part of overall wellness. Mineral Absorption & Bone Health: Vitamin D helps support and maintain mineral absorption, bone health, and muscle function. Organic Liquid Probiotic Support for Digestion: Formulated with 13 unique probiotic strains to help support and maintain digestive health. Care For Your Gut: Clinically studied Bacillus coagulans (Unique IS-2®) helps support gut function and overall gut health. Immunity Support: Helps to support and maintain immune health and function, helping your daily wellness. Help for Occasional Gas & Bloating: This easy-to-take liquid probiotic may help reduce occasional gas and bloating as well as digestive discomfort. Proprietary Probiotic Blend: Our oil-based probiotic blend contains up to 2 billion CFU per serving. Made for the Whole Family: Formulated for ages 4+, you can easily use the marked pipette to properly dose this probiotic for the whole family! At Home or On the Go: Try out our regular 4 oz bottle for everyday use, or the travel-friendly 2 oz bottle when you need TSA travel-friendly gut support! How to Take? Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Adults 18+ take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Product Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. Use within 6 months of opening. Liquid Nighttime Multimineral + Skin Renew Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Adults 18+, take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) once daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take about 10 min to 1 hour before bed, either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Product Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. Use within 6 months of opening. Organic Liquid Probiotic Suggested Use: Product naturally settles. Shake gently before use. Please avoid direct dropper contact to the skin or mouth in order to prevent product contamination and damage to the dropper. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Use the following dosage chart to assess dosage or dose as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. 4-13 Years: 1.5 mL 14+ Years: 3 mL Product Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. With 8 individual serving-size bottles each containing one fluid ounce, this travel pack is TSA-friendly! Enjoy this multimineral as a part of your bedtime routine with no hard-to-swallow pills and NO melatonin! Our Liquid Nighttime Multimineral contains seven minerals — magnesium, calcium, zinc, selenium, copper, manganese, and chromium — in a delicious and easy-to-take liquid formula. Selenium is an essential mineral that acts as an antioxidant, helping to protect cellular health. Vitamin D3 is included to help maintain healthy bones and teeth and works to aid in the absorption of minerals. This essential vitamin, along with zinc, also helps support your immune system. Additionally, zinc supports healthy hair, skin, and nails while helping to maintain nutrient metabolism. Enjoy this delicious coconut-flavored liquid multimineral in travel-friendly bottles and receive all of these nutrients with just one single-serve bottle per day! How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Adults 18+, take up to one bottle (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take about 10 min to 1 hour before bed, either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a dry, cool place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. 2287.description_text: Our best-selling multivitamin to support your beauty from within — now in a convenient, travel-friend 8-pack of single serving bottles! With clinically shown Lustriva®, this delicious liquid multivitamin helps support thicker, fuller hair and smoother skin in women. Each pre-measured 1 oz bottle also delivers essential nutrients to support energy metabolism, immunity, and overall daily wellness — no measuring required. How It Works Clinically Shown for Hair Growth: Features Lustriva®, shown in women to support thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks!^^ Supports Smoother Skin: Lustriva® also helps reduce facial wrinkles and fine lines while improving skin smoothness.^^ Daily Energy Metabolism: B vitamins help support energy metabolism, circulatory health, immunity, and the nervous system. This liquid multivitamin includes all eight B vitamins, including 10,000 mcg biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin — as well as folate as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Beauty From Within: Biotin, zinc, and B vitamins support skin, hair, and nail health. Bone & Mood Support: Vitamin D3 supports bone health, muscle function, and mood support. Healthy Metabolism: Chromium picolinate supports healthy body composition, healthy metabolism, and helps maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. Overall Wellness Made Simple: This broad-spectrum liquid multivitamin delivers 15+ nutrients in just 2 tablespoons daily with two delicious flavors to choose from! Your Routine, Your Way: Eight pre-measured, single-serve bottles make it easy to stay consistent with your beauty and wellness routine — perfect for busy mornings, travel, gym bags, or anytime you want daily nutrition on-the-go. How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Adults 18+ take up to one bottle (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. This product contains Biotin which may interfere with some blood test results.^^With 30 days of continued usage at 1 serving per day. This package provides 8 servings. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) CLP Certified,Non-GMO,Vegan,Pectin Based,No Gelatin,Dairy Free,Gluten Free,Nut Free,Soy Free,Sugar Free,GMP Facility Made Unique Selling Point Thicker Hair, Fuller Hair, Improved Wrinkles FAQs Q: Why a liquid multivitamin? A: Though we believe in a diet-first approach to health, not everyone gets the essential vitamins and nutrients that they need from diet alone. Our liquid multivitamin is in an easy-to-take formula. Q: How does Lustriva® support hair growth and improve wrinkles? A: Lustriva® is a complex that combines Bonded Arginine Silicate with Magnesium Biotinate, a new and superior form of biotin and silicon, to help grow thicker, fuller hair and reduce facial wrinkles in women. Magnesium Biotinate is a novel complex of magnesium ionically bound to biotin. This unique complex significantly increases biotin solubility 40 times greater than that of D-biotin, the type commonly found in beauty products. Q: Why this amount of chromium in the product? A: Chromium is a nutrient that may help support healthy body composition and metabolism and help maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. These new formulas include a higher dose of chromium (1000 mcg chromium picolinate) based on the efficacy of dosages used in clinical studies. These studies have not reported adverse effects associated with this dosage of chromium picolinate intake, indicating its safety in humans. Additionally, there is no upper limit established for chromium based on existing data for this nutrient. Ultimately, our best advice is to speak with your physician or healthcare professional to help you determine if this product is suitable for your needs. Q: Will this supplement help me with hair breakage? A: Unfortunately, we don’t have any specific data on how Lustriva® may affect the breakage that you might be experiencing. However, Lustriva® has been clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair in women! Q: Is this product suitable for men? A: This broad-spectrum multivitamin contains the trademarked ingredient Lustriva® which is clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair, and improve facial wrinkles and in women. The research on Lustriva was conducted solely in women and not in men. While the research on Lustriva® was conducted solely in women, these products may be used by men. There are a variety of reasons that a person's hair may start to thin, and for men, the most common reason is related to androgenic alopecia (otherwise known as “male pattern baldness”). Since androgenic alopecia is considered a health condition, it is outside our scope as a dietary supplement brand to speak about, and our best advice is to consult with a dermatologist, physician, or healthcare professional for their guidance. Q: How can I travel with your vitamins? A: We are happy to let you know that you can travel with our Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth Travel Pack with TSA-friendly travel size 1 oz bottles! Otherwise, many customers ration the appropriate amount of liquid they need for their trip and put it in a lunch box with an ice pack until they can refrigerate it when they arrive at their destination. 2292.description_text: Let your beauty from within shine through with this curated bundle including our Hair Growth Max Liposomal, Collagen Boosting Gummies, Organic Hair, Skin, & Nails Gummies, and Probiotic Beauty+ Capsules. Get support for thicker, fuller hair in women, plus added skin health, collagen production, anti-aging, gut health, and more in a variety of formulas! How It Works With this bundle, you’ll be giving your body formulas to support your inner and outer beauty! Help support hair growth goals with our Hair Growth Max Liposomal, support gut health + skin goals with our Beauty+ Capsules, and add in the Collagen Boosting Gummies and Organic Hair, Skin, & Nails Gummies to support collagen production and healthy hair, skin, and nails! Hair Growth Max Liposomal We’ve formulated a delicious almond cookie-flavored liposomal with multiple ingredients specifically selected to support your hair and skin! Our Hair Growth Max Liposomal contains 160 mg Lustriva®, which is clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair for women in as early as 3 weeks! This ingredient is also shown to reduce facial wrinkles and improve skin smoothness in women. This liposomal also contains biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin. Also included is pumpkin seed oil and a proprietary herbal blend of saw palmetto fruit, eclipta whole plant, and amla fruit. Enjoy this ultra-tasty almond cookie flavor on its own or drizzled on a variety of foods! Quick Facts About Liposomals Liposomes are tiny spherical structures that have a protective outer layer and an inner cavity to hold and transport substances such as vitamins or other nutrients to the body. These tiny structures encapsulate these substances and can lead to ultra absorption! Our products’ liposomal delivery system works by encapsulating the vitamins/nutrients into liposomal structures, allowing these nutrients to be easily absorbed in the gut. Probiotic Beauty+ Capsules This unique formulation is designed to help you feel great from the inside out—because your beauty deserves a daily boost. These vegan capsules contain probiotics for a healthy gut microbiome and beauty-supporting ingredients. Red Orange ComplexTM helps with anti-aging and promotes younger-looking skin by improving skin elasticity in as early as 14 days. Clinically shown to increase skin moisturization and reduce transepidermal water loss after 56 days of use!^^ Ceramosides® increases skin elasticity, hydration, and smoothness while improving wrinkles. Vitamin C supports immune system function and natural collagen production. Biotin helps maintain hair, skin, and nail health. Just two capsules per day provide probiotics for gut health, plus a beauty boost that works from the inside out! Clinically Tested: Ceramosides results cited above are from randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled clinical trials. ^^With 56 days of continued usage at 1 serving per day. This bottle provides 30 servings. Collagen Boosting Gummies Formulated to provide nutrients your body needs to promote its own collagen production—no animal-based collagen. Collagen provides structure to bones, skin, and connective tissue. Vitamin C and L-lysine promote natural collagen synthesis and maintain skin health. Vitamin A supports healthy skin. Amla fruit, used in Ayurvedic medicine, supports healthy hair. Delicious watermelon-flavored gummies packed with collagen-boosting nutrients. Organic Hair, Skin, & Nails Gummies Support the health of your hair, skin, and nails with tasty, crown-shaped vegan gummies! Biotin is an essential vitamin your body needs but cannot produce on its own. This water-soluble vitamin supports healthy hair and skin. Antioxidant vitamin C promotes natural collagen synthesis and skin health. Vitamin E and Vitamin C support cellular and skin health. How To Take Hair Growth Max Liposomal Suggested Use: Ages 18+ take 1 tablespoon (15 mL) daily. Can be taken directly or added to your choice of blended beverage or as a topping on a variety of foods. 2298.name_zh: Liquid Morning 复合维生素 + Hair Growth
2298.description_text: Our best-selling multivitamin to support your beauty from within! With clinically shown Lustriva®, this delicious liquid multivitamin helps support thicker, fuller hair and smoother skin in women — while also delivering daily wellness support with essential nutrients to support energy metabolism, immunity, and more. How It Works Clinically Shown for Hair Growth: Features Lustriva®, shown in women to support thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks! Supports Smoother Skin: Lustriva® also helps reduce facial wrinkles and fine lines while improving skin smoothness. Daily Energy Metabolism: Circulatory health, immunity, and the nervous system. This liquid multivitamin includes all eight B vitamins, including 10,000 mcg biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin — as well as folate as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Beauty From Within: Biotin, zinc, and B vitamins support skin, hair, and nail health. Bone & Mood Support: Vitamin D3 supports bone health, muscle function, and mood support. Healthy Metabolism: Chromium picolinate supports healthy body composition, healthy metabolism, and helps maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. Overall Wellness Made Simple: This broad-spectrum liquid multivitamin delivers 15+ nutrients in just 2 tablespoons daily with two delicious flavors to choose from! How To Take Shake well before use. Adults 18+ take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. This product contains Biotin which may interfere with some blood test results. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) B Corp Certified, Women Owned, CLP Certified, Vegan, Dairy Free, Gluten Free, Nut Free, Soy Free,Sugar Free, GMP Facility Made. Unique Selling Point Thicker Hair, Fuller Hair, Improved Wrinkles. FAQs Q: Why a liquid multivitamin? A: Though we believe in a diet-first approach to health, not everyone gets the essential vitamins and nutrients that they need from diet alone. Our liquid multivitamin is in an easy-to-take formula. Q: How does Lustriva® support hair growth and improve wrinkles? A: Lustriva® is a complex that combines Bonded Arginine Silicate with Magnesium Biotinate, a new and superior form of biotin and silicon, to help grow thicker, fuller hair and reduce facial wrinkles in women. Magnesium Biotinate is a novel complex of magnesium ionically bound to biotin. This unique complex significantly increases biotin solubility 40 times greater than that of D-biotin, the type commonly found in beauty products. Q: Why this amount of chromium in the product? A: Chromium is a nutrient that may help support healthy body composition and metabolism and help maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. These new formulas include a higher dose of chromium (1000 mcg chromium picolinate) based on the efficacy of dosages used in clinical studies. These studies have not reported adverse effects associated with this dosage of chromium picolinate intake, indicating its safety in humans. Additionally, there is no upper limit established for chromium based on existing data for this nutrient. Ultimately, our best advice is to speak with your physician or healthcare professional to help you determine if this product is suitable for your needs. Q: Will this supplement help me with hair breakage? A: Unfortunately, we don’t have any specific data on how Lustriva® may affect the breakage that you might be experiencing. However, Lustriva® has been clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair in women! Q: Is this product suitable for men? A: This broad-spectrum multivitamin contains the trademarked ingredient Lustriva® which is clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair, and improve facial wrinkles in women. The research on Lustriva was conducted solely in women and not in men. While the research on Lustriva® was conducted solely in women, these products may be used by men. There are a variety of reasons that a person's hair may start to thin, and for men, the most common reason is related to androgenic alopecia (otherwise known as “male pattern baldness”). Since androgenic alopecia is considered a health condition, it is outside our scope as a dietary supplement brand to speak about, and our best advice is to consult with a dermatologist, physician, or healthcare professional for their guidance. Q: How can I travel with your vitamins? A: We are happy to let you know that you can travel with our Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth Travel Pack with TSA-friendly travel size 1 oz bottles! Otherwise, many customers ration the appropriate amount of liquid they need for their trip and put it in a lunch box with an ice pack until they can refrigerate it when they arrive at their destination.

2299.description_text: Support your little one’s daily wellness with our tasty, sugar-free Kids Multivitamin Gummies with three flavors — strawberry, papaya, and super punch — in one bottle! Formulated with vitamins and minerals like vitamin C, vitamin D, zinc, and folate, these gummies help support normal growth and development, immunity, bone health, and overall wellness with just one gummy daily. How It Works Essential Nutrients: Provide your child with essential nutrients their growing bodies need that they may not be getting from diet alone. Immunity Support: Vitamin C, vitamin D, and zinc help support the normal function of your child’s immune system. Healthy Bones & Teeth: Vitamin D also supports the normal maintenance of bone and teeth health. Normal Growth & Development: Vitamin A supports normal vision, tissue health, and overall growth and development in children. Healthy Metabolism: B Vitamins and iodine support healthy metabolism and function of the nervous and circulatory systems. Skin & Collagen Formation: Vitamin C supports the normal formation of collagen for healthy skin, tissue, and connective structure. Kid-Friendly & Sugar-Free: Delicious, kid-approved fruity flavors that the kids will love — without the added sugar! Third-Party Tested: Formulated with care, these gummies carry the Non-GMO Project seal, a trusted standard for ingredient integrity, as well as Clean Label Project Certification for testing of 200+ toxins and contaminants. How To Take Suggested Use: Ages 4+ can take 1 gummy per day or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. If not chewed properly, this product is a potential choking hazard. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Xylitol is harmful to pets. Seek immediate veterinary care if you suspect ingestion has occurred. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) Non-GMO Project Verified, CLP Certified, Vegan, Pectin Based, No Gelatin, Dairy Free, Nut Free, Gluten Free, Soy Free, Sugar Free, GMP Facility Made, Kid Formulated. Unique Selling Point Immune Support, Bone Health, Essential Nutrients. FAQs Q: Why are some of the daily value percentages under 100%, while some are over? Wouldn’t I want my child to receive 100% of everything? A: This is a great question! Fat-soluble vitamins, like vitamins A, D & E, are vitamins that are stored in the body, in contrast to water-soluble vitamins (like B vitamins), which are expelled when consumed in excess. Since the body stores fat-soluble vitamins, excess amounts can build up and create toxicity. A varied and healthy diet should provide the body with a good portion of these vitamins, but we know that doesn’t always happen, especially if your child is a picky eater or if there are dietary restrictions involved. We have formulated this gummy multivitamin to account for these factors as best we could. We recommend consulting with your child’s physician or healthcare professional to make certain this product is appropriate for your child’s nutrient needs! Q: Do you have tips on children and vitamins? A: Yes, we have a few! First and foremost: be sure to consult with your child’s physician or healthcare professional prior to use to make sure this product is suitable for your child. This is particularly true if your child is experiencing any health challenges, is taking any medications or if your child is under the age of twelve. As much as we pride ourselves on making great tasting vitamins, we do want to advise that you keep these gummy vitamins out of reach of your children. They are not candy and they should not be treated as such. It is possible to get too much of a good thing! If you are concerned that your child may have taken too many gummies, please call the Poison Control hotline: 1 (800) 222-1222 (available 24/7). Q: My child has MTHFR gene variant(s). Is this product safe for my child(ren)? A: In general, when starting any new health and wellness supplement, you should check with your child's pediatrician, physician, or healthcare professional to make sure the supplement is suitable for your child. This is especially true when there is the added complexity of the MTHFR gene variants. We encourage you to partner with your child's healthcare professional to determine the best course of action. Q: Why is there no iron in the Kids Gummy Multivitamin? A: Iron is very difficult to formulate with, especially in gummy form. You'll be hard pressed to find a good tasting gummy multivitamin with iron that isn't overloaded with sugar. Not only that, but iron can interfere with the body's absorption of other vitamins and minerals. Micronutrient competition is important to keep in mind when formulating a gummy multivitamin for what micronutrients can be optimally absorbed, which is why we decided to not include iron in our gummy multivitamins. We do have a liquid iron supplement, in a delicious berry flavor, with easily adjusted serving sizes for the whole family! Q: Why are you updating your gummy product labels? A: We want parents to have the clearest guidance possible when it comes to using gummies with little ones. That’s why we’ve added a safety notice and updated age ranges — not because of any incidents, but to make sure families have the most up-to-date information. Gummies remain a safe and tasty option when chewed thoroughly and given with supervision, and these label updates are simply there to support parents in making confident choices. Q: Should I stop giving these gummies to my 2- or 3-year-old? A: Every child develops at their own pace, and parents — together with their pediatrician — are best positioned to decide what’s right. 2306.description_text: Our best-selling multivitamin to support your beauty from within! With clinically shown Lustriva®, this delicious liquid multivitamin helps support thicker, fuller hair and smoother skin in women — while also delivering daily wellness support with essential nutrients to support energy metabolism, immunity, and more. How It Works Clinically Shown for Hair Growth: Features Lustriva®, shown in women to support thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks!^^ Supports Smoother Skin: Lustriva® also helps reduce facial wrinkles and fine lines while improving skin smoothness in women.^^ Daily Energy Metabolism: B vitamins help support energy metabolism, circulatory health, immunity, and the nervous system. This liquid multivitamin includes all eight B vitamins, including 10,000 mcg biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin — as well as folate as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Beauty From Within: Biotin, zinc, and B vitamins support skin, hair, and nail health. Bone & Mood Support: Vitamin D3 supports bone health, muscle function, and mood support. Healthy Metabolism: Chromium picolinate supports healthy body composition, healthy metabolism, and helps maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. Overall Wellness Made Simple: This broad-spectrum liquid multivitamin delivers 15+ nutrients in just 2 tablespoons daily with two delicious flavors to choose from! How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Adults 18+ take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose.Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. This product contains Biotin which may interfere with some blood test results. ^^With 21 days of continued usage at 1 serving per day. This bottle provides 15 servings. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) CLP Certified, Vegan, Dairy Free, Gluten Free, Nut Free, Soy Free, Sugar Free, GMP Facility Made Unique Selling Point Thicker Hair, Fuller Hair, Improved Wrinkles FAQs Q: Why a liquid multivitamin? A: Though we believe in a diet-first approach to health, not everyone gets the essential vitamins and nutrients that they need from diet alone. Our liquid multivitamin is in an easy-to-take formula. Q: How does Lustriva® support hair growth and improve wrinkles? A: Lustriva® is a complex that combines Bonded Arginine Silicate with Magnesium Biotinate, a new and superior form of biotin and silicon, to help grow thicker, fuller hair and reduce facial wrinkles in women. Magnesium Biotinate is a novel complex of magnesium ionically bound to biotin. This unique complex significantly increases biotin solubility 40 times greater than that of D-biotin, the type commonly found in beauty products. Q: Why this amount of chromium in the product? A: Chromium is a nutrient that may help support healthy body composition and metabolism and help maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. These new formulas include a higher dose of chromium (1000 mcg chromium picolinate) based on the efficacy of dosages used in clinical studies. These studies have not reported adverse effects associated with this dosage of chromium picolinate intake, indicating its safety in humans. Additionally, there is no upper limit established for chromium based on existing data for this nutrient. Ultimately, our best advice is to speak with your physician or healthcare professional to help you determine if this product is suitable for your needs. Q: Will this supplement help me with hair breakage? A: Unfortunately, we don’t have any specific data on how Lustriva® may affect the breakage that you might be experiencing. However, Lustriva® has been clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair in women! Q: Is this product suitable for men? A: This broad-spectrum multivitamin contains the trademarked ingredient Lustriva® which is clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair, and improve facial wrinkles in women. The research on Lustriva was conducted solely in women and not in men. While the research on Lustriva® was conducted solely in women, these products may be used by men. There are a variety of reasons that a person's hair may start to thin, and for men, the most common reason is related to androgenic alopecia (otherwise known as “male pattern baldness”). Since androgenic alopecia is considered a health condition, it is outside our scope as a dietary supplement brand to speak about, and our best advice is to consult with a dermatologist, physician, or healthcare professional for their guidance. Q: How can I travel with your vitamins? A: We are happy to let you know that you can travel with our Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth Travel Pack with TSA-friendly travel size 1 oz bottles! Otherwise, many customers ration the appropriate amount of liquid they need for their trip and put it in a lunch box with an ice pack until they can refrigerate it when they arrive at their destination. 2312.description_text: Our best-selling multivitamin to support your beauty from within! With clinically shown Lustriva®, this delicious liquid multivitamin helps support thicker, fuller hair and smoother skin in women — while also delivering daily wellness support with essential nutrients to support energy metabolism, immunity, and more. How It Works Clinically Shown for Hair Growth: Features Lustriva®, shown in women to support thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks! Supports Smoother Skin: Lustriva® also helps reduce facial wrinkles and fine lines while improving skin smoothness. Daily Energy Metabolism: Circulatory health, immunity, and the nervous system. This liquid multivitamin includes all eight B vitamins, including 10,000 mcg biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin — as well as folate as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Beauty From Within: Biotin, zinc, and B vitamins support skin, hair, and nail health. Bone & Mood Support: Vitamin D3 supports bone health, muscle function, and mood support. Healthy Metabolism: Chromium picolinate supports healthy body composition, healthy metabolism, and helps maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. 2329.description_text: Start their mornings with a burst of nutrients with this easy-to-take, Kids Liquid Morning Multivitamin! This delicious multivitamin is packed with essential vitamins and minerals to support your child’s daily wellness. Formulated with zinc, vitamin C, vitamin D, and more, this blend supports immunity, cognitive function, and overall wellness — all in one delicious spoonful or smoothie blend. How It Works Immune Support: Vitamin C and vitamin D both contribute to the normal function of the immune system. Together, these nutrients help maintain immune function and health for kids. Cognitive Function & Development: Zinc supports and maintains cognitive function and development, making it an important nutrient for growing minds. Overall Wellness: A broad spectrum blend of vitamins and minerals contributes to maintaining overall wellness in children. Lutein from Marigold Extract: Naturally sourced from marigold flowers, lutein is included as part of this nourishing blend. Made for Kids: Not every kid gets the essential vitamins and nutrients that they need from diet alone — that’s where a kid-formulated multivitamin can help. Delicious & Easy-to-Take: Kid-approved flavors in a liquid format that children ages 1 and up will enjoy on their own or mixed into their favorite beverage! Clean Label Project (CLP) Purity Award Winner: This Kids Liquid Morning Multivitamin has been third-party tested for 200+ toxins & contaminants, verified for product label accuracy, and recognized with the CLP Purity Award. How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Take once daily following the dosing instructions listed below, or dose as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice, or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. 1-3 Years: 1/2 Teaspoon (2.5 mL) 4-13 Years: 1 Tablespoon (15 mL) Product Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) CLP Certified, Non-GMO Project Verified, Vegan, Dairy Free, Gluten Free, Nut Free, Soy Free, Sugar Free, GMP Facility Made, Kid Formulated Unique Selling Point Immune Support, Cognitive Function, Overall Wellness FAQs Q: Why are some of the daily value percentages under 100%, while some are over? Wouldn’t I want my child to receive 100% of everything? A: This is a great question! Fat-soluble vitamins, like vitamins A, D & E, are vitamins that are stored in the body, in contrast to water-soluble vitamins (like B vitamins), which are expelled when consumed in excess. Since the body stores fat-soluble vitamins, excess amounts can build up and create toxicity. A varied and healthy diet should provide the body with a good portion of these vitamins, but we know that doesn’t always happen, especially if your child is a picky eater or if there are dietary restrictions involved. We have formulated this liquid multivitamin to account for these factors as best we could. We recommend consulting with your child’s physician or healthcare professional to make certain this product is appropriate for your child’s nutrient needs! Q: Do you have any tips on kids and vitamins? A: Yes, we have a few! First and foremost: be sure to consult with your child’s physician or healthcare professional prior to use to make sure this product is suitable for your child. This is particularly true if your child is experiencing any health challenges, is taking any medications or if your child is under the age of twelve. As much as we pride ourselves on making great tasting vitamins, we do want to advise that you keep these liquid vitamins out of reach of your children. They are not candy and they should not be treated as such. It is possible to get too much of a good thing! If you are concerned that your child may have taken too much of the liquid, please call the Poison Control hotline: 1 (800) 222-1222 (available 24/7). Q: My child has MTHFR gene variant(s). Is this product safe for my child(ren)? A: In general, when starting any new health and wellness supplement, you should check with your child's pediatrician, physician, or healthcare professional to make sure the supplement is suitable for your child. This is especially true when there is the added complexity of the MTHFR gene variants. We encourage you to partner with your child's healthcare professional to determine the best course of action. Q: Why is there no iron in this Kids Morning Multivitamin? A: When formulating our liquid multivitamins, we wanted to make a multivitamin that had the best possible combination of micronutrients for optimal absorption. Since micronutrient competition is important to keep in mind when formulating the best liquid multivitamin, and iron can interfere with the body's absorption of other vitamins and minerals, we decided to not include iron in our liquid multivitamins. For those who would like to supplement with iron, we have a stand-alone Liquid Iron supplement in a delicious berry flavor for ages 4 and up, as well as Organic Toddler Iron Liquid Drops! 2339.description_text: Support your immunity, cognitive health, energy, and more with this multivitamin formula made for women before and after menopause. Our Women’s 40+ Multivitamin Liposomal combines key nutrients such as vitamin D3, B12, omega fatty acids, and more in an ultra absorption liposomal format to help support your daily wellness — all in a delicious vanilla peach flavor you’ll enjoy taking alone, in your favorite smoothie, or drizzled on top of foods! How It Works Postmenopausal Support: Bodily changes may occur as you age, which is why it’s important to support your body from the inside with essential nutrients. This tasty liquid multivitamin is formulated to support overall wellness as well as libido support in postmenopausal women. Immune Function: This multivitamin blend contains several key nutrients, including vitamin D3, omega fatty acids, and zinc, to support normal immune function in every serving. Energy Support: Vitamin B12 supports energy and the metabolism of homocysteine, an essential amino acid that helps create proteins. Cognitive & Cardiovascular Health: Omega-3 as DHA and omega-9 support cognitive and cardiovascular health Muscle Function & Bone Health: Essential nutrients magnesium and vitamin D3 support muscle function and bone health. Cellular Health: Vitamin B9, also known as folate, supports the formation of red and white blood cells, in addition to normal cell growth and division. Ultra Absorption: This tasty multivitamin comes in an easy-to-take liposomal format that supports absorption of nutrients. Liposomes are tiny spherical structures that work by encapsulating nutrients into liposomal structures, allowing these nutrients to be easily absorbed in the gut. Proprietary Botanical Blend: In addition to important vitamins and minerals, this multivitamin for women 40+ also includes a proprietary botanical blend with herbal ingredients, including maca root extract, saw palmetto berry oil, chaste tree berry extract, red clover flower extract, raspberry extract, and lutein flower. How To Take Suggested Use: Adults, take 1 Tablespoon (15 mL) daily. Can be taken directly or added to your choice of blended beverage or as a topping on a variety of foods. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. Shake gently before using. For optimal flavor and product performance, we recommend refrigeration before and after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) CLP Certified,Non-GMO,Vegan,Dairy Free,Gluten Free,Soy Free,Sugar Free*,GMP Facility Made Unique Selling Point Ultra Absorption, Immune Support, Energy Metabolism FAQs Q: What is the lifespan of this liposomal product? A: The shelf life for our Women's 40+ Multivitamin Liposomal is 12 months, when stored in a cool, dry place (preferably refrigerated), away from oxygen and moisture in its sealed container. Once open and, if kept refrigerated, the shelf life is 6 months. Q: Why isn’t vitamin C included in the formula? A: Did you know that formulating with vitamin C can be difficult?! It tends to be unstable and degrade quickly in liquid formulations, especially when included in complex formulas with multiple other vitamins and minerals. Given that vitamin C deficiency is uncommon in developed countries, and can be obtained in the North American diet through common foods such as citrus fruits, tomatoes, potatoes, and more, we opted to leave it out. If you would like to supplement with vitamin C, we do have many standalone products like our Vitamin C Liquid Drops, Megadose Vitamin C Liposomal, and Vitamin C Gummies. Q: Can anyone take this multivitamin? A: Though this multivitamin was formulated with women age 40+ in mind, that doesn’t mean that it is only appropriate for this group of people. To see if this liposomal multivitamin support is right for you, we recommend speaking with your physician or other healthcare professional. Q: What is your vegan omega-3 source? A: While most omega supplements use cod liver oil or another fishy source, our Women's 40+ Multivitamin Liposomal with Hormonal Support uses DHA derived from algal oil, which is sourced from an ocean-friendly, wild strain of sustainably-grown micro-algae. Our Algal Oil (Omega-3) supplier is a proud supporter and board member of the Global Organization for EPA & DHA Omega-3s (GOED). Your Routine, Your Way: Ages 14+ can supplement your zinc intake with 100% recommended daily value in each serving of 2 delicious tart raspberry zinc gummies. 2342.description_text: Support your body’s pregnancy & postpartum needs with this blend of essential nutrients in just 2 delicious gummies per day — no pills or capsules needed! These vegan gummies feature key nutrients including folate, iodine, and more to support mom and baby’s wellness through pregnancy and postpartum. How It Works Pregnancy Support & Postnatal Health: Pregnant and postpartum bodies undergo significant physical and hormonal changes, often requiring additional nutrients that can be supplemented. Support for Every Stage of Motherhood: Designed for pre-conception, pregnancy, and nursing, these organic gummies are here to provide essential nutrients for you and your baby's needs before, during, and after pregnancy! Folate Support for Mom & Baby: This multivitamin contains 800 mcg methylated folate as calcium l-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Adequate folate in healthful diets may reduce the risk of having a child with a brain or spinal cord birth defect. Blend of Essential Nutrients: These gummies also include six additional B vitamins like methyl B12 as well as vitamins C, D, A, and essential minerals, zinc and iodine, for you and your baby. Thyroid Function: Iodine supports prenatal and postnatal health as well as normal thyroid function. Delicious & Easy-to-Take: Enjoy just two tasty strawberry-flavored gummies per day to support preconception wellness, provide pregnancy support, and support your postnatal health! How To Take Suggested Use: For those pregnant and/or lactating, take up to 2 gummies daily, or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. A: Nutritional needs can change over a lifetime, and that is especially true in pregnancy and after you’ve given birth. It is recommended that a person who is attempting to conceive should begin supplementing in anticipation of pregnancy. This multivitamin was formulated to support you and baby from conception to after you’ve given birth. Q: What is the best time of day to take the Prenatal & Postnatal Multivitamin? A: The best time of day to take our Prenatal & Postnatal Multivitamin is in the morning, with or without food; your call! Pregnancy nausea may get the best of you, so you may prefer to take it with your breakfast. What is most important is that you take the vitamins consistently. A: While this multivitamin includes a variety of essential and important nutrients for prenatal and postnatal health, we recommend speaking with your physician or healthcare professional for your specific wellness needs. A: Since our bodies and nutrient needs vary greatly over time, the best answer to this question may likely be discovered when collaborating with your physician or healthcare professional, considering your personal needs, health goals and any health concerns you may be facing! That said, the general consensus is to take a postnatal multivitamin for six months after birth or for as long as you may be lactating and nursing. 2347.description_text: Our best-selling multivitamin to support your beauty from within! With clinically shown Lustriva®, this delicious liquid multivitamin helps support thicker, fuller hair and smoother skin in women — while also delivering daily wellness support with essential nutrients to support energy metabolism, immunity, and more. How It Works Clinically Shown for Hair Growth: Features Lustriva®, shown in women to support thicker, fuller hair in as early as 3 weeks! Supports Smoother Skin: Lustriva® also helps reduce facial wrinkles and fine lines while improving skin smoothness. Daily Energy Metabolism: Circulatory health, immunity, and the nervous system. This liquid multivitamin includes all eight B vitamins, including 10,000 mcg biotin magnesium biotinate, a unique form of biotin that is 40x more soluble than D-biotin — as well as folate as calcium L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate! Beauty From Within: Biotin, zinc, and B vitamins support skin, hair, and nail health. Bone & Mood Support: Vitamin D3 supports bone health, muscle function, and mood support. Healthy Metabolism: Chromium picolinate supports healthy body composition, healthy metabolism, and helps maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. Overall Wellness Made Simple: This broad-spectrum liquid multivitamin delivers 15+ nutrients in just 2 tablespoons daily with two delicious flavors to choose from! How To Take Shake well before use. Adults 18+ take up to 2 tbsp (30 mL) daily or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. This product contains Biotin which may interfere with some blood test results. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) B Corp Certified, Women Owned, CLP Certified, Vegan, Dairy Free, Gluten Free, Nut Free, Soy Free,Sugar Free, GMP Facility Made. Unique Selling Point Thicker Hair, Fuller Hair, Improved Wrinkles. FAQs Q: Why a liquid multivitamin? A: Though we believe in a diet-first approach to health, not everyone gets the essential vitamins and nutrients that they need from diet alone. Our liquid multivitamin is in an easy-to-take formula. Q: How does Lustriva® support hair growth and improve wrinkles? A: Lustriva® is a complex that combines Bonded Arginine Silicate with Magnesium Biotinate, a new and superior form of biotin and silicon, to help grow thicker, fuller hair and improve facial wrinkles in women. Magnesium Biotinate is a novel complex of magnesium ionically bound to biotin. This unique complex significantly increases biotin solubility 40 times greater than that of D-biotin, the type commonly found in beauty products. Q: Why this amount of chromium in the product? A: Chromium is a nutrient that may help support healthy body composition and metabolism and help maintain a healthy blood sugar level already within a normal range. These new formulas include a higher dose of chromium (1000 mcg chromium picolinate) based on the efficacy of dosages used in clinical studies. These studies have not reported adverse effects associated with this dosage of chromium picolinate intake, indicating its safety in humans. Additionally, there is no upper limit established for chromium based on existing data for this nutrient. Ultimately, our best advice is to speak with your physician or healthcare professional to help you determine if this product is suitable for your needs. Q: Will this supplement help me with hair breakage? A: Unfortunately, we don’t have any specific data on how Lustriva® may affect the breakage that you might be experiencing. However, Lustriva® has been clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair in women! Q: Is this product suitable for men? A: This broad-spectrum multivitamin contains the trademarked ingredient Lustriva® which is clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair, and improve facial wrinkles in women. The research on Lustriva was conducted solely in women and not in men. While the research on Lustriva® was conducted solely in women, these products may be used by men. There are a variety of reasons that a person's hair may start to thin, and for men, the most common reason is related to androgenic alopecia (otherwise known as “male pattern baldness”). Since androgenic alopecia is considered a health condition, it is outside our scope as a dietary supplement brand to speak about, and our best advice is to consult with a dermatologist, physician, or healthcare professional for their guidance. Q: How can I travel with your vitamins? A: We are happy to let you know that you can travel with our Liquid Morning Multivitamin + Hair Growth Travel Pack with TSA-friendly travel size 1 oz bottles! Otherwise, many customers ration the appropriate amount of liquid they need for their trip and put it in a lunch box with an ice pack until they can refrigerate it when they arrive at their destination. 2355.description_text: Enjoy this essential amino acid in a delicious snickerdoodle liposomal format for ultra absorption! Our vegan-sourced Lysine Liposomal provides the body with tissue and bone support while also playing a key role in the formation of collagen. Enjoy this sweet and smooth blend on its own, mixed into your favorite drink, or drizzled as a tasty topping! How It Works Vegan-Sourced L-lysine: Lysine is an essential amino acid that our bodies need, but cannot make on their own. Try this vegan-sourced l-lysine supplement delivered via liposomes in an easy-to-take liquid for ultra absorption! Tissue Support & Collagen Formation: Amino acids are the building blocks of protein! As an amino acid, lysine supports tissue health by helping collagen formation. Bone Health & Muscle Protein Synthesis: Lysine also supports bone health and maintains muscle protein synthesis for healthy muscles. 2361.description_text: Support your brain, nervous system, and red blood cells with this delicious strawberry vegan B12 spray! Suitable for many with the MTHFR gene, this USDA organic B12 spray helps maintain your body’s normal energy levels and brain function by supporting neuro health! How It Works Bioavailable Methylcobalamin: Many B12 supplements are often filled with artificial flavors or use cyanocobalamin, a synthetic form of B12 that contains cyanide. Our natural strawberry flavored B12 Spray is made with methylcobalamin, which has superior bioavailability to cyanocobalamin and is a preferred form for some with MTHFR gene variants! Neuro & Energy Support: With 720 mcg B12 per serving, this spray supports the body’s nervous system, supports brain function, and provides energy to those who are deficient. DNA Synthesis & Cellular Health: B12 also aids the body in DNA synthesis and red blood cell production. Your Routine, Your Way: Enjoy this easy-to-take spray on the go for wellness support that helps you move forward each day — no pills or capsules needed! How To Take Suggested Use: Shake gently before use. Adults, take 4 sprays daily and swallow or take as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. IMPORTANT: B12 is a natural dye and as such the natural red pigment of the methylcobalamin may stain! Make sure to use caution when taking this product so as to preserve your clothes and surroundings! A: While both sprays are 1 oz and contain B12 as methylcobalamin, they do have some differences. This Methyl B12 Organic Spray contains 30 servings of 720 mcg Vitamin B12 (as Methylcobalamin) and is strawberry flavored. The Organic Methyl B12 Spray contains 120 servings of 1500 mcg Vitamin B12 (as Methylcobalamin) and is berry flavored. Both sprays also have varying other ingredients as the base carrier. Q: Why is the B12 so red? Is there dye in here? A: No! We don’t use artificial colors in our products. The red of the spray is naturally occurring due to B12’s molecular structure. But keep in mind that B12 can stain, so be cautious when spraying this product! Q: Will taking B12 give me more energy? A: Some people find that taking B12 increases their energy levels, but this is a result of treating a deficiency. B12 deficiency is common amongst certain groups such as older adults, vegetarians, and vegans. This delicious, ultra absorption formula combines a blend of herbs and oils as well as Lustriva®, clinically shown to help grow thicker, fuller hair in women, while also improving facial wrinkles, fine lines, and skin smoothness. This unique complex significantly increases biotin solubility 40 times greater than that of D-biotin, the type commonly found in beauty products. Q: Will this supplement help me with hair breakage? 2377.description_text: Support rest and relaxation with these berry-flavored Kids Melatonin Gummies! Help your child fall asleep faster and support better sleep quality with this easy-to-take gummy that contains melatonin. 60 count | 30-60 servings How It Works Wind down and support a calming mood and restful night’s sleep with melatonin. Melatonin, a hormone naturally produced by the body’s pineal gland in response to darkness, helps the timing of your circadian rhythm as well as sleep. Some studies have shown that supplemental melatonin may improve the time to fall asleep and the total amount of sleep. Though there is no Recommended Daily Allowance (RDA) for melatonin, it has been suggested that the timing of ingestion, rather than the amount of the dose, is more important for melatonin to be most effective for sleep. We recommend ingesting the gummies 20-30 minutes prior to bedtime. These gummies come in a delicious berry flavor kids will love! How To Take Suggested Use: Ages 4+, take 1 gummy at or 20-30 minutes before bedtime, or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Important: Consult with your physician before use if you are taking any medications, including those for sleep. Do not use in conjunction with alcoholic beverages, when driving a vehicle, or while operating machinery.
