2379.description_text: Support your overall wellness with a deliciously sweet and tangy multivitamin thoughtfully formulated for women 40 and up! MaryRuth’s Women’s 40+ Multivitamin Gummies provide essential vitamins and minerals plus Chaste Tree Berry to help maintain overall health and well-being during this stage of life. How It Works Women’s Health & Wellness: These multivitamin gummies were formulated with ingredients specifically to support wellness for women aged 40+ with just 2 gummies daily! Bone Health: Vitamins A and D3 help support bone health and contribute to overall wellness. Vitamin D3 also maintains mineral absorption and supports normal muscle function. Energy Metabolism: Vitamins B6, B12, pantothenic acid, and iodine help maintain normal energy-yielding metabolism. Cognitive Function: B6, B12, folate, pantothenic acid, and iodine help support cognitive function. Skin, Hair, & Nail Health: Biotin is an essential vitamin that helps support skin, hair, and nail health — supporting beauty from within! Vitamin C also supports skin health by supporting the muscular system, connective tissue, and collagen production. Immune Support: Vitamin C, vitamin D3, vitamin B12, and zinc contribute to normal immune function. Cellular Health: Vitamins C and E act as antioxidants that help support cellular health. Nervous System Function: Pantothenic acid is essential to almost all forms of life and helps maintain neurotransmitter synthesis. Thyroid Health: Iodine is especially important for thyroid function, supporting hormone production, while playing an important role in energy metabolism and central nervous system function. With Chaste Tree Berry: Traditionally used to help relieve symptoms of menopause, such as hot flushes. Chaste Tree Berry may also provide premenstrual support for the relief of common symptoms of premenstrual syndrome for women aged up to 45 years old. How To Take Suggested Use: Ages 40+ take up to 2 gummies daily, or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Warning: Xylitol is harmful to pets. Seek immediate veterinary care if you suspect ingestion has occurred. NOTE: Herbal supplements may not be appropriate for everyone. Herbal products may interfere with certain medications or complicate health conditions. 2382.description_text: Support your growing toddler’s wellness with multiple essential nutrients in delicious mixed berry & cherry flavored gummies! Give your child just one vegan gummy daily for 10 essential vitamins and minerals, plus a postbiotic. How It Works Bone & Teeth Health: Vitamin D3 (here in vegan form) helps support healthy bones and teeth as well as calcium and phosphate levels, which are required for bone mineralization. Normal Growth & Development: Vitamin A promotes normal growth and development in children, supporting tissue and bone health and good vision. Cellular Health: Vitamin E is another essential antioxidant that is important for cellular health. Energy Metabolism: B vitamins support blood cell production, DNA production, circulatory health, and energy metabolism. Immune Support: Zinc is a trace mineral that supports normal growth, cellular health, and is essential for maintaining a healthy immune system. Postbiotic Blend: Support your toddler’s health with all of these nutrients, plus Bifidobacterium lactis and Lactobacillus rhamnosus as postbiotics. Overall Wellness: Essential vitamins and minerals to help maintain your little one’s wellness in just one delicious gummy per day. How To Take Suggested Use: Ages 2+, take 1 gummy per day, or as recommended by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Store in a cool, dry place. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) USDA Organic,CLP Certified,CLP Purity Award,Non-GMO,Vegan,Pectin Based,No Gelatin,Dairy Free,Gluten Free,Nut Free,Soy Free,Made with Organic Sugar,GMP Facility Made,Toddler Formulated Unique Selling Point Immunity, Bone Health, Energy Metabolism FAQs Q: Why are some of the daily value percentages under 100%, while some are over? Wouldn’t I want my child to receive 100% of everything? A: This is a great question! Fat-soluble vitamins, like vitamins A, D & E, are vitamins that are stored in the body, in contrast to water-soluble vitamins (like B vitamins), which are expelled when consumed in excess. Since the body stores fat-soluble vitamins, excess amounts can build up and create toxicity. A varied and healthy diet should provide the body with a good portion of these vitamins, but we know that doesn’t always happen, especially if your child is a picky eater or if there are dietary restrictions involved. We have formulated this gummy multivitamin to account for these factors as best we could. We recommend consulting with your child’s physician or healthcare professional to make certain this product is appropriate for your child’s nutrient needs! Q: My child has MTHFR gene variant(s). Is this product safe for my child(ren)? A: In general, when starting any new health and wellness supplement, you should check with your child's pediatrician, physician, or healthcare professional to make sure the supplement is suitable for your child. This is especially true when there is the added complexity of the MTHFR gene variants. We encourage you to partner with your child's healthcare professional to determine the best course of action. Q: Why is there no iron in these gummies? A: Iron is very difficult to formulate with, especially in gummy form. You'll be hard-pressed to find a good-tasting gummy multivitamin with iron that isn't overloaded with sugar. Not only that, but iron can interfere with the body's absorption of other vitamins and minerals. Micronutrient competition is important to keep in mind when formulating a gummy multivitamin for what micronutrients can be optimally absorbed, which is why we decided to not include iron in our gummy multivitamins. We do have a liquid iron supplement, in a delicious berry flavor, with easily adjusted serving sizes for the whole family! 2386.name_zh: Liquid Morning 复合维生素 Travel Pack
2386.description_text: The very first product MaryRuth ever created, and still a best seller — now in a convenient, travel-friendly 8-pack of single serving bottles! This delicious liquid multivitamin is made for the whole family, with each pre-measured 1 oz bottle delivering essential nutrients to support energy metabolism, immunity, bone health, and more — no measuring required! How It Works Daily Nutrient Support: Our very first formula, created to make it easier than ever to get nutrients your body needs — in a delicious, easy-to-take liquid multivitamin. Broad-Spectrum Formula: A nourishing blend of essential vitamins and minerals, including antioxidant vitamin C, plus vitamins D, E, and beta carotene. Energy Metabolism Support: B vitamins help support energy metabolism and a healthy nervous system. B-Vitamin Blend: Includes B6, biotin, folate, pantothenic acid, and bioavailable B12 to support important functions — from circulatory health to mood and cognitive performance. Antioxidant Properties: Vitamin C supports your body by helping limit free radical damage and protecting cells from oxidative stress, contributing to immune function and overall wellbeing. Immunity & Bone Support: Vitamin D3, the same type of vitamin D produced when your skin is exposed to sunlight, supports bone health and immune function. Your Routine, Your Way: Eight pre-measured, single-serve bottles make it easy to stay consistent with your beauty and wellness routine — perfect for busy mornings, travel, gym bags, or anytime you want daily nutrition on-the-go. How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before use. Ages 14+, take up to one bottle (30 mL) once daily or take as directed by a physician or healthcare professional. Do not exceed the recommended dose.. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) Certified B Corp,Women-Owned,CLP Certified,CLP Purity Award,Non-GMO,Vegan,Dairy-Free,Gluten-Free,Nut-Free,Soy-Free,Sugar-Free,GMP Facility Made,Family Formulated Unique Selling Point Energy Metabolism, Immune Support, Essential Nutrients FAQs Q: How should I use this? Can I take it with drinks or food? A: We suggest that everyone start with ½, or even ¼, the recommended dose to see how their body responds. You may see that you do better with a smaller dosage because our formula is potent! It can be taken on an empty stomach or with food, or mixed into your favorite cold beverage. Q: How can I travel with your vitamins? A: We are happy to let you know that you can travel with our Liquid Morning Multivitamin Travel Pack with TSA-friendly travel size 1 oz bottles! Otherwise, many customers ration the appropriate amount of liquid they need for their trip and put it in a lunch box with an ice pack until they can refrigerate it when they arrive at their destination. Q: I’m not feeling a difference when taking this, why? A: Many of our customers see immediate results, or improvements. However, some of our customers don’t feel any difference at all. Many changes the multivitamin will have on you will be strictly internal and show results in bloodwork or better digestion. Regardless, please reach out if you are not satisfied with the product. Q: Why is there no iron in the Liquid Multivitamin? A: When formulating our liquid multivitamins, we wanted to make a multivitamin that had the best possible combination of micronutrients for optimal absorption. Since micronutrient competition is important to keep in mind when formulating the best liquid multivitamin, and iron can interfere with the body's absorption of other vitamins and minerals, we decided to not include iron in our liquid multivitamins. For those who would like to supplement with iron, we have a stand-alone Liquid Iron supplement in a delicious berry flavor! Q: Do the 1 oz bottles need to be refrigerated? A: Since this is a travel pack, and each 1 oz bottle is a single serving for ages 14+, no refrigeration is necessary unless you decide to take a smaller dose and not finish the entire bottle. Store them in a cool, dry place. However, some prefer to put the multivitamins in the fridge for the taste. We’d recommend not doing so until you have arrived at your travel destination. Take just one gummy daily to help support mineral absorption, cognitive function, red blood cell health, and more. Make daily wellness easy with tasty strawberry-flavored gummies — no hard-to-swallow pills needed. Cellular Health: D3 also helps to support cellular health by maintaining normal gene expression and cellular functions. Bioavailable Vitamin B12: B12, as methylcobalamin, has superior bioavailability to cyanocobalamin and is a preferred form for some people who have an MTHFR gene variant! A: Our D3 is sourced from lichen! Q: What kind of B12 is in this? Is it safe for me if I have MTHFR gene variants? A: We use Methylcobalamin in our D3+B12 Gummies. Navigating B-vitamins and MTHFR gene variants can be tricky! While there is a considerable amount of information coming out on genetic variations and how they affect our biochemistry and health, the MTHFR variants are not yet fully understood, including how various B-vitamins affect any given individual. In general, when starting any new health and wellness supplement, you should check with your physician or healthcare professional to make sure the supplement is suitable for you and your health. This is especially true when there is the added complexity of the MTHFR gene variants. We encourage you to partner with your healthcare professional to determine the best course of action. Q: How do I know if I am B12 deficient? A: There are different symptoms associated with a B12 deficiency, including problems with focusing and energy. A B12 deficiency can also cause more problems in addition to a lack of energy and trouble focusing. Lacking vitamin B12 can make your extremities feel numb or tingly, an uncomfortable side effect that can often indicate a nutrient deficiency. Though these are just some of the symptoms, we recommend consulting with your physician or healthcare professional to see if you are truly deficient, and to make certain supplementing is appropriate for your nutrient needs! Q: What’s the difference between the Sugar-Free Raspberry, Organic Strawberry, and Non-Organic Strawberry D3 + B12 Gummies A: All three of our D3 + B12 gummy variations provide the same vitamin formula and potency to support your daily routine. Each serving delivers 25 mcg (1,000 IU) of Vitamin D3 as cholecalciferol and 250 mcg of Vitamin B12 as methylcobalamin. The differences come down to flavor, sweetener, and ingredient sourcing. Our Sugar-Free Raspberry gummies are raspberry flavored and made without sugar. Our Organic Strawberry gummies are strawberry flavored, made with organic ingredients, and sweetened with organic cane sugar. Our Strawberry gummies are also strawberry flavored and sweetened with organic cane sugar, but are not certified USDA Organic. All three options are vegan, pectin-based (not gelatin), and can be enjoyed by the whole family ages 4 and up. No matter which you choose, you’ll receive the same D3 + B12 formula, so you can simply select the flavor and ingredient style that best fits your preferences. 2395.description_text: Support your gut with our best-selling probiotic pick! This vegan, USDA Organic probiotic delivers 13 unique probiotic strains, including Bacillus coagulans Unique IS-2® to support gut health, digestive health, immunity, and help reduce occasional gas and bloating — all in an easy-to-take, flavorless liquid. How It Works Support for Digestion: Formulated with 13 unique probiotic strains, including Bacillus coagulans Unique IS-2® to help support and maintain digestive health. Care For Your Gut: Clinically studied Bacillus coagulans Unique IS-2® also helps support gut function and overall gut health. Immunity Support: Helps to support and maintain immune health and function, helping your daily wellness. Help for Occasional Gas & Bloating: This easy-to-take liquid probiotic may help reduce occasional gas and bloating as well as digestive discomfort. Proprietary Probiotic Blend: Our oil-based probiotic blend contains up to 2 billion CFU per serving. Made for the Whole Family: Formulated for ages 4+, you can easily use the marked pipette to properly dose this probiotic for the whole family! A: In general, everyone — children and adults — should check with their physician, pediatrician, or healthcare professional before beginning any new wellness supplement to make sure the supplement is suitable for their health. Your physician, pediatrician, or healthcare professional knows you and/or your children best, knows what other supplements or prescriptions you or your child are already on, as well as knowing if you, or your child, are facing any health challenges. Available in both unflavored and flavored forms, this easy-to-take formula provides support for your immune system, skin health, and overall wellness. Zinc is a vital trace mineral that your body can’t produce on its own, so adding it to your daily routine helps you cover an important wellness foundation — all in a convenient liquid form. How It Works Immune Support: As an antioxidant, zinc supports immunity. The optimal concentration of zinc in the body is necessary for healthy immune function, and homeostasis of this mineral plays a role in supporting the health of your body’s macrophages, an important component of your innate immune system. Essential Mineral: From skin health to DNA synthesis to cellular metabolism, zinc contributes to essential processes throughout the body. Overall Wellness: If you’re looking to supplement this essential trace mineral, these liquid zinc drops are a simple way to support your daily health needs, either unflavored or in strawberry lemon flavor. How To Take Suggested Use: Shake gently before use. Please avoid direct dropper contact to the skin or mouth in order to prevent product contamination and damage to the dropper. A: Zinc plays many roles within the body that support the immune system and is crucial for the normal function and development of cells that are important for immune function. Macrophages, an important part of a healthy immune system, depend on zinc homeostasis to perform properly. Since many cells depend on zinc, cell proliferation will not occur with a zinc deficiency and these cell systems, such as the immune system, will not function properly. As an essential mineral for the immune system, make sure you are keeping adequate zinc levels in your body to support this process! Q: How does Zinc support skin health? A: The skin is an organ that is continuously renewing itself and has many zinc-dependent cells to do so. As the third-most zinc-abundant tissue in the body, the skin requires zinc to act as a cofactor in over 1,000 enzymatic reactions and over 2,000 transcription factors in the skin. Zinc homeostasis is necessary for skin to properly perform actions needed to maintain itself. Q: What is the purpose of the glycerin in this product? Bioavailable Vitamin B12: B12, as methylcobalamin, has superior bioavailability to cyanocobalamin and is a preferred form for some people who have an MTHFR gene variant! Easy-to-Take Vegan D3 & B12: These gummies are available in two tasty flavors: sugar-free raspberry or strawberry (sweetened with organic cane sugar) to support your levels of these essential vitamins! A: All three of our D3 + B12 gummy variations provide the same vitamin formula and potency to support your daily routine. Formulated with methylcobalamin, a bioavailable form of vitamin B12, this berry-flavored liquid spray makes it simple to help support your body’s nervous system function. Energy Metabolism: Vitamin B12 supports energy metabolism, giving you the targeted and convenient support you need on your busy days. Cognitive Function: Vitamin B12 also supports cognitive function, nervous system function, and neuro health. Energy Metabolism Support: B vitamins, including vitamin B12, contribute to energy metabolism and maintenance of the nervous and circulatory systems — nutrients your body relies on every day. 2409.name_zh: Liquid Morning 复合维生素 Essentials+
2409.description_text: Meet Essentials+, a fresh take on our best-selling original liquid morning multivitamin! This enhanced formula delivers the same great daily wellness support you love, now with added vitamin K2, minerals, and fruit blend with elderberry alongside a lineup of vitamins and minerals. With support for energy metabolism, immune function, and bone health, this liquid multi makes it easy for the whole family (ages 1+) to get the nutrients they need. How It Works Essentials+ Liquid Multi: Our essentials+ formula differs from our original liquid multivitamin as it provides minerals, amino acids, and multiple essential vitamins, plus vitamin K2 as MK-7 and a fruit blend with elderberry. Energy Metabolism Support: B vitamins, including vitamin B12, contribute to energy metabolism and maintenance of the nervous and circulatory systems — nutrients your body relies on every day. Immune Support: Vitamins A, C, D, and E all work to support immune function, important for everyday wellness. Beauty Benefits: Vitamin A helps maintain skin health, while vitamin C supports collagen synthesis, all working together to nurture beauty from within. Bone & Joint Support: Vitamin D helps maintain bone and joint health, while vitamin K2 supports calcium absorption for healthy bones. Vascular Support: Bioactive K2 (Menaquinone-7) is beneficial for strong bones, helping calcium bind into the bone matrix. Vitamin K2 also supports heart health by maintaining a healthy vascular system. Overall Wellness, Simplified: A blend of vitamins and minerals that provides broad support for everyday wellness in an easy liquid form with two delicious flavor options for the whole family. How To Take Suggested Use: Shake well before using. Adults take 2 tablespoons once daily. Take in the morning either with food, juice or on an empty stomach. Suggested Dosage: 1-3 Years: 1/2 Teaspoon (2.5 mL) 4-13 Years: 1 Tablespoon (15 mL) 14+ Years: 2 Tablespoons (30 mL) In order to make the best health decisions possible for your child, we always recommend speaking with your pediatrician, physician, or healthcare professional to help determine the best dose for your child. Keep out of reach of children in case of accidental overdose or choking. Store in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening. How It Works Disclaimer KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN We genuinely care about all our customers. Please consult with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement, especially if pregnant or lactating, taking medication, or if you have a medical diagnosis. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. Unique Value Proposition (UVP) CLP Certified, CLP Purity Award, Non-GMO, Vegan, Dairy Free, Gluten Free, Sugar Free, GMP Facility Made, Family Formulated Unique Selling Point Energy Metabolism, Immune Support, Beauty FAQs Q: Why is there no daily value for Vitamin K on the supplement fact panel? A: The preamble to the proposed rule noted that there are three general forms of vitamin K: Phylloquinone (vitamin K1), menaquinone (vitamin K2), and menadione (vitamin K3) (id.). For labeling purposes, there is no specific definition for vitamin K and the AI for vitamin K is based on the intake of phylloquinone, the major form of vitamin K in the diet. Thus, the final rule establishes, in § 101.9(c)(8)(iv), an RDI for vitamin K of 120 mcg based on the AI that pertains only to phylloquinone." The FDA determined to change this because they do not believe that studies on menaquinone provide sufficient evidence to suggest that menaquinones affect vitamin K absorption and utilization. If you’d like to read the FDA’s full argument, you may do so by clicking here. Q: Why is there no iron in the Liquid Multivitamin? A: When formulating our liquid multivitamins, we wanted to make a multivitamin that had the best possible combination of micronutrients for optimal absorption. Since micronutrient competition is important to keep in mind when formulating the best liquid multivitamin, and iron can interfere with the body's absorption of other vitamins and minerals, we decided to not include iron in our liquid multivitamins. For those who would like to supplement with iron, we have a stand-alone Liquid Iron supplement in a delicious berry flavor! Q: Are the bottles BPA-free? A: Yes, the brown and white bottles we use for our multis are BPA free. Q: I’m not feeling a difference when taking this, why? A: Many of our customers see immediate results or improvements. However, some of our customers don’t feel any difference at all. Many changes the multivitamin will have on you will be strictly internal and show results in bloodwork. Regardless, please reach out if you are not satisfied with the product. Q: How can I travel with your vitamins? A: We are happy to let you know that you can travel with our raspberry-flavored Liquid Morning Multivitamin Travel Pack with TSA-friendly travel size 1 oz bottles! Otherwise, many customers ration the appropriate amount of liquid they need for their trip and put it in a lunch box with an ice pack until they can refrigerate it when they arrive at their destination. Q: Can I give this multivitamin to children? What is the dosing? A: Yes, children, ages two and up, can use our formula. However, before you give the multivitamin to your children, we highly recommend that you show our formula to your physician, pediatrician or healthcare professional to see if our formula is right for your child. Your healthcare professional knows your child’s health best, including what other supplements or prescriptions your child may be taking, as well as knowing if your child is facing any health challenges. We recommend that the child's physician, pediatrician or healthcare professional approve all new wellness supplements. Your healthcare professional can also assess an appropriate dosage for your child. Each child is unique and different, and we want to make sure that they receive the best care possible! Prenatal & Postnatal Wellness: Formulated to support your needs before, during, and after pregnancy, this Prenatal & Postnatal Multivitamin Liposomal has a vitamin and mineral complex to support the nutrient needs of you and your baby at every stage. Fetal & Maternal Health: With ingredients like vitamin A, choline bitartrate, and potassium iodide, you know you’re providing important nutrients for you and baby. Individuals who consume an adequate amount of folate in a healthful diet may reduce the risk of having a child with a brain or spinal cord birth defect. 2446.description_text: Iron Is Important For Toddlers! Our liquid Iron comes from bioavailable Ferrochel®, otherwise known as ferrous bisglycinate chelate, a unique form of iron that may have higher absorption rates and increased tolerability than iron salts. Iron is important for toddlers as it may support energy metabolism, a growing body, and overall health. This essential mineral is a critical component of hemoglobin and myoglobin, proteins of red blood cells and muscle cells respectively. Red blood cells — through their relationship with hemoglobin — accept, store, and transport oxygen throughout the body as needed. Adequate oxygen levels are crucial for good health, and sufficient iron intake helps ensure that your toddler gets the oxygen they need! We also have a Liquid Iron formulated for ages 4 and up and for those pregnant & lactating! Each bottle comes with 60 servings. **These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Children under 12, seniors over 65, pregnant and lactating women should always consult with a physician or healthcare professional prior to use. 2457.description_text: Support for Women 40 & Over During and After Menopause Bodily changes may occur as you age, which is why it’s important to support your body from the inside with essential nutrients. This tasty liquid multivitamin is formulated to support overall wellness as well as libido support in postmenopausal women. When exposed to sunlight, your body naturally produces Vitamin D3 — the same type of Vitamin D included in this formula! Vitamin D is an essential vitamin that supports healthy sleep, normal muscle function, healthy bones, and the immune system. Vitamin B12 — here as methyl B12 — supports energy levels and aids in amino acid metabolism, while folate (vitamin B9 as methylfolate) helps the formation of red and white blood cells, cell growth, and proper cell division. 2466.description_text: The Power Of Mushrooms! Mushrooms have been used for culinary and therapeutic purposes for generations, and this Functional Mushrooms Liposomal blend contains four traditionally-used mushrooms: King Trumpet, Reishi, Turkey Tails, and Antrodia. Antrodia Mushroom, used in traditional medicines of Taiwan, may have neuroprotective properties. The Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum) Mushroom is known for its adaptogenic properties, and as such may help promote feelings of calm and ease stress. The King Trumpet (Pleurotus eryngii) Mushroom (also known as King Oyster) may have neuroprotective properties, though only limited studies have been completed. The Turkey Tails (Trametes versicolor) Mushroom has many immune-supporting properties, along with the other mushrooms included here. This mushroom blend also includes a Tocotrienols Complex. Tocotrienols, which are chemicals found in Vitamin E, potentially have better antioxidant function than their better-known counterparts in Vitamin E, tocopherols. Additionally, these components have antioxidant properties and, unlike tocopherols, neuroprotective properties.These functional mushrooms, tocotrienols, and other beneficial ingredients included may be more bioavailable when delivered via liposomal technology. Liposomes are tiny spherical structures, with a protective outer layer and an inner cavity, to hold and transport substances such as vitamins or other nutrients to the body. Try out this delicious salted chocolate liposomal supplement with components encapsulated by liposomes for enhanced absorption! Each bottle comes with 30 servings. **These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. 2498.description_text: A Vitamin For Mommy And Me! Designed for Every Stage: Formulated for every stage of motherhood, this liquid multivitamin has a vitamin and mineral complex to support the nutrient needs of you and your baby before, during, and after pregnancy. Gentle Support: Since your body is going through many physical and hormonal changes while pregnant and after giving birth, additional nutrients are often needed which can be obtained through supplementation. Promote Healthy Fetal Development: Adequate folate intake as part of a healthful diet may reduce the risk of certain birth defects, supporting healthy fetal growth. This multivitamin contains 600 mcg of folate as Calcium L-5-Methyltetrahydrofolate. Nutritional Support for Mom & Baby: With ingredients like vitamin A as beta carotene, choline bitartrate, and potassium iodide, you know you’re providing important nutrients for you and your baby. Easy-to-Take Liquid: No more pills! Help prepare your body for pregnancy and promote healthy fetal development with this tasty berry-flavored liquid multivitamin. Here to Support You: If you’re looking to supplement with iron, DHA and EPA, we also have Prenatal & Postnatal Liquid Iron and Prenatal & Postnatal Omega-3 Liquid Drops, so you can combine the supplements that you need! 32 oz | 32 servings **These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Since all bodies are different, an individual’s nutrient needs are unique to their body. As such, results may vary. Children under 12, seniors over 65, pregnant and lactating women should always consult with a physician or healthcare professional prior to use. This product is formulated for those pregnant, nursing, or are trying to get pregnant. We genuinely care about all our customers, which is why we always suggest consulting with a physician or healthcare professional before starting any health supplement. Discontinue use if any negative reaction occurs. †Folic acid is the recommended folate by the CDC for all women of reproductive age who could become pregnant. Our Organic Infants Vitamin C Liquid Drops come from PurC® Vitamin C (from organic acerola fruit extract), which has been found to contain higher levels of Vitamin C than citrus fruits. Vitamin C’s antioxidant properties are vital for the body’s processes, limiting the damage done by free radicals while supporting your infant’s immune function which supports overall well-being. Vitamin C is also an essential cofactor in the synthesis of collagen, a protein vital to the health of multiple parts of the body including blood vessels, bones, and skin! These liquid drops are an easy way to incorporate more Vitamin C into your infant’s routine!We also have Organic Vitamin C Liquid Drops formulated for Toddlers (1-3 Years) & for Ages 4+!
